name: glm53-cache-sweep
description: GLM-5.3-Flash REAP50 llama.cpp prefix-cache ladder 100k-950k on 2x L40.
caveats: llama.cpp has one active KV slot and a host prompt cache, not a multi-prefix GPU tree; multi-branch GPU reuse, RAM-vs-GPU KV tiers and multi-agent cache capacity are NOT measured.
The probe never issues a cold miss request; miss time is inferred from the cumulative fill.
Q4_K_S (87.1 GiB) and IQ4_XS (82.0 GiB) fit 96 GB differently; this recipe pins IQ4_XS for headroom.
Start this inside an allocation: cache-sweep.sh starts its own llama.cpp server.
cache-sweep.sh requires the patched llama.cpp fork built by llm/glm53-reap50/install.sh.
